about_the_game:
Modulea — a planet so rare, it’s said to be formed entirely from a special cosmic energy.
Only here can powerful “modules” be created—devices capable of drastically enhancing space battleships.
Every space-faring nation wants a piece of it.
And at the center of this galactic struggle… is you, the rightful owner of Modulea.

Take control of a space battleship and face relentless enemy fleets attacking in waves.
With each wave, enemies grow stronger and more numerous. Defeat them to earn gold and modules to power up your ship.
But modules are more than simple upgrades.

Using a unique inventory-based placement system, each module’s shape, position, and combination affects your battleship’s power.
Experiment with different builds every run and discover new strategies to overcome the odds.

What’s the ultimate loadout?
That depends on your choices. A humble ship can become a devastating war machine—with the right configuration.

Key Features

  • High-difficulty 2D roguelike bullet hell action

  • Real-time battleship upgrades using gold and modules

  • Inventory-based module placement system for endless build possibilities

  • Strategically combine modules to adapt your playstyle

  • Face increasingly powerful boss waves

  • One mistake can mean destruction—stay sharp!

  • Unique module combinations make every run feel fresh and different

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 / AMD Radeon HD 5770 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 compatible sound card
